title: c0mpiled-16 teaser — CRT
why: One locked-off shot of a CRT in green light playing hackathon footage and countdown type; the most distinctive single idea in the archive.

title: An Invitation — Gliderport Potluck
why: Handwritten invite, parking-garage run, sunset silhouette, hand-drawn light trails; matches the sunset-silhouette reel on Instagram.

title: Christmas at JW
why: Cleanest hospitality piece: shallow-focus decor, Santa buggy, choir, families; finished and graded.

title: The Guy Next to Me — Arjun Prakash
why: Grotesk-on-cream title system, dot-grid data graphics and synced captions; the strongest of the five final podcast cuts.

title: Potluck Social — recap
why: Vertical recap with serif title card, guest lower-thirds and 'get funded / get connected' script supers; latest version (v4).

title: Red Saree
why: Best of four Dira reels: foreground foliage, detail inserts, logo end card, warm peach grade.

title: Eight Hours
why: The whole hackathon told by an on-screen clock with chapter pills and closing stat cards; the most designed of the twelve v10 interview reels.

title: Eera
why: Editorial jewellery portrait work with calla lilies, soft window light and a blurred logo resolve.

title: SIC Pickleball Social
why: 16 s sunset film with script titles, whip pans and motion-blur cutting; a different register from the indoor recaps.

title: A Wedding at Fairfield
why: Night venue film with drone passes over the red lawn setup ending on fireworks and the hotel logo; latest render (72.5 s), the site holds an earlier 75 s one.

title: All the People
why: Applicant headshots multiply into a mosaic that resolves into the hackathon poster.

title: Kapoor Jewellers
why: Macro gold on dark green velvet with slow rotation and a logo end card.

title: SIC Is Hiring: Marketing (but with a twist)
why: Surreal maze-head poster with a figure climbing the stairs; the best of the animated posters and the only one longer than 5 s.

title: Dor Foundation — documentary film
why: Six-minute film with student interviews, lower-thirds and the Governor; the substantial Dor piece.

title: Dor jingle film
why: One-minute montage cut to the Dor anthem with Hindi lyric titles; shorter and warmer than the documentary.
